name: JellyBoost
overview: Per-user volume boost for movies and shows on every Jellyfin client
description: Boosts quiet movie audio. Desktop browsers apply the boost instantly in the web player; TVs, mobile apps and other native clients get the boost applied by the server during an audio-only transcode (video is still copied).

versions.changelog: Build against Jellyfin 12.0 so the plugin loads on every 12.x server.
